content.short: Neynar is the primary infrastructure provider and owner of the Farcaster protocol, powering its social ecosystem.
content.description:
Neynar is the definitive infrastructure and API provider for Farcaster, the leading decentralized social network. Following its acquisition of the protocol in 2026, Neynar serves as the primary maintainer of Farcaster's core clients, indexing services, and the Clanker ecosystem. The platform provides developers with robust SDKs and high-performance tools needed to build, scale, and manage social applications within a transparent and permissionless framework.

By simplifying the complexities of on-chain social data, Neynar empowers builders to focus on user experience while maintaining the core benefits of decentralized identity and content ownership. The protocol supports a vibrant ecosystem of frames, casts, and interactive social apps across the Ethereum and Base networks. Through its commitment to developer accessibility and ecosystem growth, Neynar has become the foundational layer for the next generation of social media, where users have true control over their digital interactions.
content.meta: Neynar provides essential infrastructure, APIs, and protocol maintenance for the Farcaster decentralized social network.
